## Walkthrough

Defines `NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY` in `Makefile-deps.mk` to wrap `hack/testing/retry.sh` and prefixes numerous `go install` invocations (golangci-lint, controller-gen, kustomize, envtest, ginkgo, gotestsum, kind, yq, helm, genref, hugo, mdtoc, helm-docs, mockgen) with `@$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY)`.

## Changes

**Network-resilient tool installations**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY definition and initial application** <br> `Makefile-deps.mk`|`NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY` variable is defined to invoke `hack/testing/retry.sh` with fixed attempts, delay, backoff, and streaming settings. The `golangci-lint` target is updated to prefix its `go install` command with `@$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY)`.|
|**Consistent retry wrapper application across remaining tool targets** <br> `Makefile-deps.mk`|Remaining tool-install targets (`controller-gen`, `kustomize`, `envtest`, `ginkgo`, `gotestsum`, `kind`, `yq`, `helm`, `genref`, `hugo`, `mdtoc`, `helm-docs`, `mockgen`) now prefix their `go install` commands with `@$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY)`.|

<details>
<summary>🧹 Nitpick comments (2)</summary><blockquote>

<details>
<summary>Makefile-deps.mk (2)</summary><blockquote>

`76-77`: **Operational consideration: Maximum retry duration.**

With 8 attempts and exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds, a tool installation can take up to ~8.5 minutes in the worst case (2+4+8+16+32+64+128+256 seconds) per tool if all retries are exhausted. The `--stream` flag should provide visibility during retries, but developers should be aware that tool installation targets may now take significantly longer during persistent network issues.

This is reasonable for handling transient proxy.golang.org failures, but consider documenting this behavior for developers who might encounter longer-than-expected build times.

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

In `@Makefile-deps.mk` around lines 76 - 77, Add documentation or an inline
comment explaining that NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY (the variable defined as
"$(PROJECT_DIR)/hack/testing/retry.sh --attempts 8 --delay 2 --exponential
--stream -- env") can lead to up to ~8.5 minutes of retry time per tool under
worst-case exponential backoff; update either the Makefile-deps.mk near the
NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY definition or the project README/devdocs to state the
maximum retry duration, why the setting exists (to tolerate transient
proxy/network failures), and how to adjust --attempts/--delay if developers want
shorter/longer timeouts.
```

</details>

`89-89`: _⚡ Quick win_

**Inconsistent command echo suppression.**

Line 89 is missing the `@` prefix present on other tool installation targets (lines 80, 93, 97, 101, etc.). This will cause the full retry command to be echoed to stdout, unlike the other targets.

If this is intentional (perhaps for additional debugging visibility given the echo on line 88), consider documenting it. Otherwise, add `@` for consistency.





<details>
<summary>🔧 Proposed fix for consistency</summary>

```diff
-	$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY) GOBIN=$(BIN_DIR) GO111MODULE=on $(GO_CMD) install sigs.k8s.io/controller-tools/cmd/controller-gen@$(CONTROLLER_GEN_VERSION)
+	@$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY) GOBIN=$(BIN_DIR) GO111MODULE=on $(GO_CMD) install sigs.k8s.io/controller-tools/cmd/controller-gen@$(CONTROLLER_GEN_VERSION)
```
</details>
